What is a toner probe (tone generator) used for?
Locating and identifying a specific cable among many
How does a toner probe work?
A generator sends a tone on a cable that a probe detects at the other end
What is a cable tester used for?
Verifying wiring, continuity, and faults in a cable
Which fault can a cable tester reveal?
Opens, shorts, reversed, crossed, or split pairs
What is a network tap used for?
Copying traffic from a link for monitoring or capture
Which advantage does a hardware tap have over port mirroring?
It captures all traffic, including errors, without using switch resources
What is a Wi-Fi analyzer used for?
Examining wireless channels, signal strength, and interference

What is a visual fault locator used for?
